claims.text: Large Language Models possess capabilities in fundamental responsibilities of language understanding and generation.
Large Language Models possess generalization capabilities and reasoning skills.
Large Language Models can be used as feature encoders to learn representations of users and items in recommender systems.

evidence.description: The paper notes LLMs have revolutionized NLP/AI 'due to their remarkable abilities in fundamental responsibilities of language understanding and generation'.
The paper highlights LLMs' 'impressive generalization capabilities and reasoning skills'.
The paper surveys representative methods that 'harness the power of LLMs (as a feature encoder) for learning representations of users and items'.

methodologies.name: Literature Survey and Taxonomy of LLM-Empowered Recommender Systems
methodologies.description: A systematic review categorizing LLM-empowered recommender systems across pre-training, fine-tuning, and prompting paradigms.

limitations.text: DNN-based recommender systems exhibit difficulties in effectively understanding users' interests.
DNN-based recommender systems struggle to capture textual side information effectively.
DNN-based recommender systems lack generalizability across various seen and unseen recommendation scenarios.
DNN-based recommender systems are unable to reason on their recommendations.

future_work.text: Exploring promising future directions in the emerging field of LLM-empowered recommender systems.
